Test a robust trimmed mean to see if trimming the top/bottom errors improves on the median, given the strong trend and unstable ranking.
Try a classic inverse-error weighted combo on the full pool to see if a simple weighted scheme beats the robust median.
try a robust deterministic weighted average (dba) on the full pool to see if it beats median.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced pool (trend‑dominated, unstable ranking) using inverse_error to see if a simple weighted scheme improves over median.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend, so a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
test a robust softmax weighted combiner on the smaller, stable pool4 to see if it improves over median.
trend_dominated, stable ranking across windows but unstable overall; robust median works well, but a mean on a smaller, more stable pool4 may capture the trend better.

The series has unstable ranking and strong trend, so a robust weighted combiner using a forward‑selection based weight (w1) on the full pool may capture complementary strengths better than the previously tried inverse or softmax weights.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend, so a robust combiner on a smaller, more stable pool may improve over full‑pool median.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9889. Series context: trend strength 0.9081 and seasonal strength 0.0934; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.166.
